name: Shared memory
description: Shared memory for all agents, as in Claude Desktop: facts about the user and common rules are in every agent's context, and are written to one shared folder; each agent also learns its knowledge base folders

dir.description: Absolute path to the shared memory folder: USER.md, MEMORY.md (index), memory/*.md (facts)

knowledge.description: Knowledge base folders by agent id ("*" for every agent): absolute paths of note folders the agent searches and may write to
